scope: All 55 audited native editor option groups now represented or retain their existing native constraints. Schema and converter parity does not add publishing, account provisioning, or binary-upload workflows.

comparison.notes: Native Crop is contain plus 1.33x scaling. It retains letterboxing; Fill uses cover. Poster and video transforms verified in the browser.

nativeConstraints.backgroundVideo: Native renderer always autoplays, mutes and loops; these are not editable standalone-style toggles for backgrounds.
nativeConstraints.videoFit: YouTube and website mode force Fit. Editor disables the choice for those contexts.
nativeConstraints.cardDefault: Editor supports Default/inherited in addition to Light/Dark; AI resolves omitted theme to Dark.
nativeConstraints.filterOpacity: Alpha/opacity editing is available for eligible expanded image layouts, not contained covers.
nativeConstraints.youTubeBackground: YouTube fit controls are disabled in the editor. The native background renderer additionally scales its wrapper by viewport; objectFit alone does not promise an uncropped YouTube background.

verification.scopedLint: passed for changed API, admin and shared UI files
verification.fullProjectLint: Not completed: journeys-admin lint exceeded Node heap. Scoped changed-file lint passed with an increased heap.
verification.serviceHealth: Frontend, Tailscale frontend, gateway, journeys, media, languages, analytics and users all HTTP 200 on final check.

fixesFoundDuringVerification: Qwen structured-output compiler rejects regex lookarounds from Zod email schema. Provider schema omits unsupported patterns; complete original Zod validation remains on server.
Builder now receives recent messages and the current request so exact edit values are not lost when the planner summarizes them.
Kept steps are derived from actual edit targets and missing untouched steps are restored.
remainingWorkflowLimits: Drafts still live in browser storage; this chunk does not create or publish database journeys.
Existing image and owned ready Mux assets can be referenced. Creating uploads remains the native editor workflow.
Existing integration/route IDs can be represented. Creating or selecting account integrations remains the account workflow.
Subtitle availability, chat feature flags, template controls and analytics still depend on the native source/runtime. Live subtitle playback and user-uploaded Mux playback were not exercised.
Model adherence remains imperfect. During testing it changed poll labels and omitted requested links; schema/converter coverage is not a generation-quality benchmark.
